rationale: Reviewed full-field upstream templates with exact arithmetic action and integer overflow meaning. Tests cover the primary-versus-alternative clause distinction, reversed polarity, added exceptions, and finite regex budgets. No per-function semantic cards or function-name decision branches are used.

record.name: documented_elementwise_operation
record.description: The exact upstream summary identifies an element-wise arithmetic operation; input domains and exception policies remain separate.

record.name: documented_integer_overflow_policy
record.description: The upstream contract states what happens on integer overflow. This does not describe floating-point exceptional behavior or prove a different execution context.
